author: Netuxx
body:
I was on Plug.Plugged (i'm currently right now) lonely, waiting for someone to come, when i remember one day i read Howsie saying that he needs to organize more Events for Plug. Dj.
So, all of a sudden it comes to my mind "Event Manager" and i through, why not have people who manage events every 1-2 weeks with cool stuff on it? followed of that i thought: "Well, if he got a Event Manager rank, why not commands and stuff for that rank? Something like "/setreward <objective> <xp amount>".

So basically, for who didn't want to read the previous paragraph, i thought on a new rank called Event Manager. People with that rank should have access to Plug. Dj mayor ranks and new cool commands that would help them to manage events.

Thanks for reading and sorry for my bad English! 
~ Netux

Well, i think i didn't explain myself right, so for who did understand and want to make others understand too just leave a better explanation on the white rectangle under this text (or maybe is at last page of this post? Idk, don't want to update the post every time for that)
